tasks.brief: Offline fail-closed ledger separating historical, current and simulated records; HTTPS provenance and confidence for historical records; deterministic export; synthetic tests only.

Implement a stdlib SQLite global football catalog foundation, sections 3-7 of docs/mega-patch-specification.md. Own only tools/world_catalog.py, tests/test_world_catalog.py, docs/world-catalog.md. Persistent stable IDs for countries, associations, competitions, seasons spanning years, clubs, players, coaches and memberships. Field provenance (source HTTPS URL, observed/effective timestamps, confidence) and separate catalog/generated/playable capability states. Foreign keys, duplicate rejection, transaction rollback. No invented production data; synthetic fixtures only in tests. No collection/network, game binary edits, website edits, dependencies, publication or broad audits. Keep scope small enough for 8 minutes. Write meaningful tests for invalid references, rollback, homonyms distinct by IDs, stable club identity across division changes, season spans. Run configured checks. Return concise evidence and limitations.

Implement deterministic incremental snapshots for tools/world_catalog.py in tools/world_snapshot.py with tests/test_world_snapshot.py and docs/world-snapshot.md only. Read preceding catalog API. Sections 7,23,24,31 of specification. Stable content hashes excluding observation clock; identical content yields no new content version; source failure/empty input must preserve previous trusted fields; conflicts retained for reconciliation; atomic snapshot write, provenance and diff, dry-run support. Synthetic fixtures only, no network/API paid services or game files. Prove unchanged data, changed field, missing source, crash before atomic replace and conflict preservation. Do not claim live sports update. Run configured unittest and git diff --check.

Define an offline daily source intake boundary using only explicit local JSON cache files, HTTPS provenance, bounded source count and bytes, fail-closed validation, deterministic snapshot integration, and zero network requests. Synthetic fixtures only; no live collection or publication.
